parts.text: Choosing the drone and the way it flies is my legal responsibility, and our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us. Drones are of several models from different manufacturers, and they differ in how much they can carry, how far they can fly on a full battery, which sensors they carry like cameras, thermal cameras, or laser scanners, and which charging connector they use. I want help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts, and I do this while several dispatchers plan at the same time for the same busy sites and popular drones.
